name: To The Lonely A Home
source:
A Visual Novel about you as a person trying to find a new home in a world unlike your own, but through uncommon circumstances, you are aided by a power that you haven't even thought of yet.

And the same power seems to like you as well, so, will you find a home with your mentor or perhaps someone more modest?

[From [url=https://arknoars.itch.io/to-the-lonely-a-home]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，讲述了你作为一个人试图在一个与你自己的世界不同的世界中寻找新家的故事，但在不寻常的情况下，你得到了一种你从未想过的力量的帮助。

同样的力量似乎也喜欢你，所以，你会和你的导师或者更谦虚的人一起找到一个家吗？

[来自[url=https://arknoars.itch.io/to-the-lonely-a-home]Itch.io[/url]]
